verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an on-device and hosted inference engine, so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, memory fragmentation handling, or concurrent request capacity. The only related items are NPU acceleration and kernel validation claims, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
